yaya.regex.label: Regex replacement rules
yaya.regex.desc: Replace user input and AI output by regex: choose who it applies to, display-only or raw text, plain text or HTML
yaya.regex.cfg_rules_desc: Each rule: {pattern, flags, replacement, target: user|ai|both, mode: visual|raw, format: regex|html}; the editor on this page is easier
yaya.regex.hint: Rules apply in order; $1 references a capture group, $& is the whole match. HTML fragments only apply to AI output, and matched text inside them is auto-escaped.
yaya.regex.empty: No rules yet — press “Add rule” below
yaya.regex.saved: Saved — UI updates now (raw text changes apply from the next message)
